question: What is the ratio of posts with more than 100 views to posts with less than 100 views?

question: How many different elements are present in molecules labeled '+' with more than 10 atoms?

question: List the elements of atoms in molecules that contain only single bonds and are not labeled as toxic.

question: What is the ratio of accounts with monthly fees to those with weekly fees?

question: Which districts had more than 100 transactions involving the keyword 'PREVOD NA UCET' in 1997?
sql: SELECT T2.a2 FROM district AS T2 INNER JOIN account AS T1 ON T2.district_id = T1.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T3.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1997' AND T3.k_symbol LIKE '%PREVOD NA UCET%' GROUP BY T2.a2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;

question: Which badges were awarded to users who made edits to posts tagged with '<r>'?

question: What is the percentage of molecules with more than 10 atoms that contain both oxygen and nitrogen atoms?
sql: WITH large_molecules AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 10), oxygen_and_nitrogen AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM large_molecules AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element IN ('o', 'n') GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element) = 2) SELECT CAST(COUNT(oxygen_and_nitrogen.molecule_id) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(large_molecules.molecule_id) AS percentage_oxygen_and_nitrogen FROM large_molecules LEFT JOIN oxygen_and_nitrogen ON large_molecules.molecule_id = oxygen_and_nitrogen.molecule_id;

question: What is the total number of accounts owned by clients who were born after 1950?

question: Rank molecules by the average bond length (assuming all bonds are single bonds)

question: How many unique molecules contain at least three atoms of type 'o'?

question: What percentage of accounts have a frequency of bi-weekly statements compared to all accounts?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE frequency = 'BI-WEEKLY') * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_bi_weekly_fee_accounts FROM account;

question: Rank the users based on the total number of votes they have received.

question: Among posts with between 50 and 100 answers, what is the average view count per post?

question: What percentage of bonds in molecule 'TR000' are double bonds?

question: What is the total number of unique atoms involved in the bond with ID 'TR001_2_6'?

question: Which 5 posts with the most upvotes are tagged with 'Python'?
sql: SELECT P.Title, P.Body, P.Score FROM posts AS P JOIN posthistory AS PH ON P.Id = PH.PostId JOIN tags AS T ON P.Tags LIKE '%<python>%' ORDER BY P.UpVotes DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders were placed by the account with ID 101?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order WHERE account_id = 101;

question: How many comments were created before the year 2012?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creationdate) < 2012

question: How many cards were issued by female clients?
sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.card_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN card AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.disp_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F'

question: What is the total amount of money transferred out (VYDAJ) on account number 456?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 456 AND type = 'VYDAJ';

question: Which districts had the highest total transaction amounts in 1997?
sql: SELECT T2.a2, SUM(T3.amount) AS total_amount FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T3.date) = 1997 GROUP BY T2.a2 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 districts by the total number of accounts.
sql: SELECT T2.a2, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id GROUP BY T2.a2 ORDER BY account_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many unique molecules contain both carbon and hydrogen atoms?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element IN ('c', 'h')

question: What is the bond type between atoms TR001_5 and TR001_6?
sql: SELECT T3.bond_type FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR001_5' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR001_6'

question: What percentage of loans have a duration of more than 3 years?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE T1.duration > 36)::FLOAT * 100 / COUNT(*)) AS long_term_loans_percentage FROM loan AS T1

question: What is the most common type of card issued to clients from districts with more than 10000 records?
sql: SELECT T1.type FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id GROUP BY T1.type HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id GROUP BY T1.type) AS T)

question: How many cards were issued to the owner of account number 303?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id WHERE T2.account_id = 303 AND T2.type = 'OWNER';

question: What is the percentage of accounts that have been active for over 10 years?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(date)) > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM account

question: What is the sum of all transactions made by accounts located in the 'Central Bohemia' region?
sql: SELECT SUM(T3.amount) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T1.a3 = 'central Bohemia'

question: What is the total amount of loans issued in the year 2019?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2019

question: Find the count of unique molecules that contain at least one bond of type '#'.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#'

question: Calculate the total number of transactions per day for accounts that were created in the year 2015.
sql: SELECT DATE(T3.date) as transaction_date, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM account AS T2 INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T2.date) = 2015 GROUP BY transaction_date

question: How many votes were cast on posts by users under the age of 25?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.userid = T2.id WHERE T2.age < 25

question: When was the last time a user named 'Alice' made a comment?
sql: SELECT MAX(T1.creationdate) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.userid = T2.id WHERE T2.displayname = 'Alice'

question: What is the average reputation of users who have posted more than 10 answers?
sql: SELECT AVG(reputation) FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE answercount > 10)

question: Find the display names of users who have received exactly 10 votes on their posts.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.displayname FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.owneruserid INNER JOIN votes AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.postid GROUP BY T1.displayname HAVING COUNT(T3.id) = 10

question: How many loans were taken out in 1998 by clients who have at least 5 accounts?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) FROM loan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 1998 AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5)

question: List all unique bank names used in transactions made by female clients.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.bank FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T3.gender = 'F'

question: How many molecules contain exactly three bonds?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 3)

question: Find the average number of bonds per atom across all molecules.
sql: SELECT AVG(COUNT(*)) FROM (SELECT atom_id FROM connected GROUP BY atom_id)
